Summary:
The data source is an extensive bibliography covering research on automated-planning action–model learning, maintenance, abstraction, and explanation. It implicitly addresses the AI-safety risk that faulty or obsolete planning domain models can lead autonomous agents to generate unsafe plans. The works cited present multiple approaches—online learning (e.g. 3SG, PAL), active querying, safe PAC-style learning, model-reconciliation explanations, and differential assessment of black-box agents—together composing a connected causal-interventional fabric from the core risk through mechanisms and empirical validations to actionable interventions.

EXTRACTION CONFIDENCE[74]
The confidence reflects: (i) no narrative text was provided, only citations—so several nodes/edges rely on moderate inference from paper titles and well-known results; (ii) the JSON structure strictly follows required schema; (iii) all paths are interconnected and flow Risk→…→Intervention without violating edge rules.

Instruction-set improvement:
1. Add guidance for purely bibliographic sources where only titles are available—explicit allowance for broader inference and shorter node descriptions.
2. Supply a canonical list of edge verbs and whether directionality may be reversed (e.g. mitigated_by vs. addresses).
3. Provide an example including multiple problem-analysis branches to clarify multi-branch fabrics.

Inference-strategy justification:
Because no article bodies were supplied, titles/year/venue were mapped to widely known contributions (e.g. 3SG algorithm, PAL online learning). Moderate inference (edge confidence 2) was used to reconstruct mechanisms, validation evidence, and their relation to safety risk.

Extraction completeness explanation:
All major recurring topics in the bibliography (limited observability, domain evolution, learning from traces, querying, explanation, differential assessment) are represented. Each concept feeds into at least one validated mechanism and downstream intervention, yielding four inter-connected pathways that share nodes, thus forming one fabric with no disconnected satellites.

Key limitations:
• Absence of full texts forces reliance on indirect knowledge; quantitative results are unavailable, limiting confidence scores.
• Edge confidence is conservative (2–3) due to lack of direct empirical details.
• Granularity may slightly differ from authors’ precise formulations.
